The '''1,001st stormtrooper division''', known as the '''Knighthunters''', were an elite group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] serving in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. As Krayt and the [[One Sith]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|assumed control]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the One Sith enacted a [[Third Jedi Purge|purge]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], eliminating [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Knighthunters became a key part of the Imperial purge.

The specialized stormtroopers who comprised the Knighthunters fell under the direct command of the Sith. To aid their commanders in their crusade, the stormtroopers of the 1,001st [[Division/Legends|division]] underwent specialized training to aid in the capture or [[Death/Legends|killing]] of Jedi. They were armed with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber-resistant]] [[Phrik/Legends|phrik-laced]] [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] and protected by jet-black armor based on [[Coruscant Guard armor|that]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. 

==History==
At the conclusion of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith-backed]] forces of the [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] led a [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup]] that merged his [[One Sith]] with the deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s forces into a single [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. Simultaneously, the Sith enacted a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Third Jedi Purge|purge]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], forcing any surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to go into hiding. To aid the Sith, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] 1,001st stormtrooper [[Division/Legends|division]] were drafted to hunt down the remaining Jedi and capture them&mdash;or [[Death/Legends|kill]] them, if necessary.<ref name="LECG" />

Command of the Knighthunters, as they came to be known, was transferred from the Army hierarchy and placed into the hands of the Sith. Personally trained by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], the Knighthunters learned to defend themselves against any trick a Jedi was capable of. By the completion of their advanced training, the elite stormtroopers were more than able to block [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks, negate the effects of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], and counter the extreme athleticism of Jedi and similar foes. However, this training was not without its risks&mdash;Knighthunter training boasted a high fatality rate.<ref name="LECG" />

Regardless of the hazardous training they received, Knighthunters performed exceptionally well at their job. Upon the discovery of a Jedi's location, a Sith Lord would procure a detachment of Knighthunters to accompany him or her in confronting the Jedi. The Knighthunters' presence increased the odds of capturing or killing their opponent; likewise, it also decreased the odds of the Jedi either escaping or killing the Sith. The elite troops would do whatever was necessary to complete their objective.<ref name="LECG" />

==Armor and equipment==
Like other elite units, Knighthunters had access to an assortment of equipment that standard stormtroopers did not. Their durable armor, painted jet-black, was modeled after [[Coruscant Guard armor|that]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]],<ref name="LECG" /> which watched over the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the days of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SotESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> It also combined elements of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] armor. Knighthunters' helmets also featured a special device capable of disrupting Force mind influences: a small connector located at the base of the neck sent electrical impulses, which negated the effects of Force [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]], into the wearer's brain and spine.<ref name="LECG" />

To stay true with their philosophy of swarming Jedi with a flurry of melee attacks, the Knighthunters utilized weapons that would provide adequate when fighting a lightsaber-equipped opponent. The elite stormtroopers' most commonly used weapon was an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]], laced with [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] so as to deflect lightsaber attacks. When forced to engage in ranged combat, the Knighthunters employed [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] rather than traditional [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], as lightsabers were not able to deflect the output of sonic weapons.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 1,001st stormtrooper division was introduced in [[2009]]'s ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="LECG" />
